title: IPC admin.endpoints.add params
description: Add an endpoint (IPC 3.0, LOCAL-IPC.md §The endpoint set's methods; ADR-0061 decisions 2 and 5, ADR-0067 decisions 3, 4 and 6). `key` is the entry's `key` value, the name `<EndpointId>.key` of a key file the client sealed under `<state_dir>/endpoint-keys/` before the call -- a name, never a path and never key material, which crosses the IPC in neither direction; `alias` and `allowed_client_kinds` are the entry's. Whether `key` and `alias` are in their grammars is the METHOD's to answer, by name (`id_not_derived`, `alias_invalid`), so a string outside them is a well-formed request. Closed: no `id` (derived), no `advertise` (the add writes false), no `enabled` (an added endpoint is enabled), no `inbound` or `outbound` (its two own sets are written empty).

key.description: The key file's name; the method answers `id_not_derived` for a value that is not `<EndpointId>.key`.

alias.description: The alias as the client typed or derived it, judged by the METHOD against the alias grammar `^[a-z][a-z0-9._-]{0,63}$` and answered `alias_invalid` outside it; the bound here only refuses an absurd string before the method reads it.

allowed_client_kinds.description: Client kinds permitted to lease the endpoint, the entry's; empty for no restriction. Hygiene, never authority.
